Title: Dune
Author: Frank Herbert
Description: Frank Herbert's 1965 science fiction novel follows Paul Atreides after his family takes control of the desert planet Arrakis, the only source of the valuable spice melange.

Title: Gone Girl
Author: Gillian Flynn
Description: A psychological thriller in which Amy Dunne disappears on her fifth wedding anniversary, and suspicion falls on her husband, Nick.

Title: The Hobbit
Author: J.R.R. Tolkien
Description: Tolkien's 1937 fantasy novel follows the hobbit Bilbo Baggins, who joins a company of dwarves and the wizard Gandalf on a quest to reclaim the Lonely Mountain from the dragon Smaug.

Title: Educated
Author: Tara Westover
Description: A memoir by Tara Westover about growing up in a survivalist family in rural Idaho, with little formal schooling, and later earning a PhD at the University of Cambridge.

Title: Clean Code
Author: Robert C. Martin
Description: A guide to writing readable, maintainable software, covering naming, functions, comments, error handling, and refactoring, with worked case studies.

Title: Communications of the ACM, Vol. 68 No. 3
Author: Association for Computing Machinery
Description: Monthly journal of the ACM covering computing research, practice, and policy. March 2025 issue.

Title: Nature, Issue 8012
Author: Nature Publishing Group
Description: Weekly international journal publishing peer-reviewed research across the sciences.

Title: IEEE Software, Jan/Feb Issue
Author: IEEE Computer Society
Description: Bimonthly magazine on software engineering practice, aimed at working software professionals.

Title: Attention Is All You Need
Author: Ashish Vaswani et al.
Description: Introduces the Transformer, a sequence modelling architecture based entirely on attention mechanisms, without recurrence or convolution.

Title: A Relational Model of Data for Large Shared Data Banks
Author: E. F. Codd
Publisher: Association for Computing Machinery (Communications of the ACM, Vol. 13, No. 6)
Description: The foundational 1970 paper proposing the relational model for databases, which became the basis for SQL.

Title: Late-Life Migration and Information and Communication Technology
Author: Lei et al.
Description: A CHI 2024 study of how information and communication technology supports older adults who migrate late in life.

Title: Dell Latitude 5440 Laptop
Author: Library
Description: 14-inch laptop with 16 GB RAM and 512 GB SSD, available for short-term loan.

Title: iPad Air 11-inch
Author: Library
Description: Tablet with Wi-Fi, 128 GB storage, and a protective case.

Title: Canon EOS R50 Camera Kit
Author: Library
Description: Mirrorless camera with kit lens, battery, charger, and SD card.

Title: Raspberry Pi 5 Starter Kit
Author: Library
Description: Single-board computer with power supply, case, and microSD card.

Title: Harry Potter and the Sorcerer's Stone
Author: J.K. Rowling
Description: The first book in the Harry Potter series. Orphaned Harry Potter learns he is a wizard and begins his first year at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry.
